newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish 1997 grain crop seen up 7 pct -ministry.
newsitem.headline: Finnish 1997 grain crop seen up 7 pct -ministry.

text.p: Finland's total grain crop this year is expected to be about seven percent larger than in 1996, the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry said.
The total is expected to rise to 3.97 million tonnes, and almost all crops are expected to be above average this year, the ministry said in a statement.
The feedgrain crop is expected to be some 3.43 million tonnes, up eight percent on 1996, it said.
The barley crop is seen rising 13 percent to 2.09 million tonnes, while the oats crop is expected to be up one percent on last year to 1.27 million tonnes.
But owing to lower per-hectare wheat yields, the foodgrain crop this year is expected to fall one percent to just under 539,000 tonnes.
The forecast said the autumn wheat crop would be 97,000 tonnes, down 10 percent, the spring wheat crop 378,000 tonnes, up eight percent, and the rye crop 64,000 tonnes, down 26 percent on last year.
The forecast follows a survey of farms in mid-July.
